comment: Independent getpos.c auto_describe() witness: a petless Archeologist farlooks, turns on the target menu with '!', then presses 'm' and 'M' with no other monster on the map. getpos_menu() prints 'You cannot detect any monsters.', and auto_describe()'s custompline(SUPPRESS_HISTORY | OVERRIDE_MSGTYPE | NO_CURS_ON_U) then replaces that unacknowledged line through show_topl() instead of joining it.
